title: Antonio Machado's birth chart
metaDescription: Antonio Machado's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 3.0° Leo. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The Sun stands at 3.0° Leo, in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. Of everything the chart can be read for without a birth time, that is the loudest single fact in it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: 3.0° of Leo is the Sun's exact seat — first decan, 0°–10°, sub-ruled by the Sun in the old triplicity scheme. The degree is the address; the sign is only the street.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Mercury was at 13.5° Cancer, Venus was at 17.2° Cancer, Mars was at 21.4° Sagittarius. Read together: thought steeped in tone and memory; attraction that works by atmosphere; effort spent in bursts and openings.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Closest first: the Sun to Neptune, a square with 0.0° of slack. The old texts treat a square as the aspect you feel earliest and thank latest: obstruction first, competence afterwards. Behind it, Jupiter trine Saturn at 0.4°, and Saturn square Pluto at 0.7° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The dignity table, which predates the outer planets and only ever spoke for seven, marks three placements here. The Sun in Leo at 3.0° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; the Moon in Taurus at 11.6° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Saturn in Aquarius at 24.2° is in domicile. The table describes circumstance rather than quality — a planet in detriment is inconvenienced, not diminished.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Tallied where the signs are certain — 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day — the chart gives fire 3, earth 3, water 2, air 2, and fixed 6, cardinal 3, mutable 1 across the modes. Saturn was retrograde — motion that reverses only from this vantage point, and which the old reading treats as delay used for revision.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Taurus for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 14.2° between midnight and midnight. Fast enough that its degree is approximate, slow enough that its sign is not in doubt. At the noon reference it stands at 11.6°.
